notes.raw:
Modals should have a 100px top offset by default. When the viewport is too short, reduce the offset to 24px and constrain the modal’s height, leaving 24px at the bottom.

The content area should scroll internally, keeping the header, close button and footer actions visible. Background page scrolling should remain locked.

This appears to be a global issue across the app. Could we check whether it can be fixed in the shared modal component so the behavior is consistent everywhere?
notes.title: Modal positioning and scrolling behavior
notes.body: Modals should have a `100px` top offset by default. When the viewport is too short, reduce the offset to `24px` and constrain the modal's height, leaving `24px` at the bottom. The content area should scroll internally, keeping the header, close button and footer actions visible, while background page scrolling remains locked. Could this be fixed in the shared modal component for consistency across the app?
